name: Ryoujoku Toritate
source:
Main character is a debt collector specializing in women. Since it's a job to collect money with whatever means possible, he finds weak spots in body and mind and draws victims to the world of terror. When debtor can't pay himself, his relatives and friends get involved as well.You have to return what you borrow!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名专门向女性讨债的债务催收员。既然工作要求用一切手段收钱，他就会找出目标身心上的弱点，将受害者引向恐怖世界。当债务人本人无法偿还时，亲友也会被卷入其中。借了什么，就必须还什么！

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
